room_rent.display: No cap (Domestic); Single Private AC Room (International)
room_rent.note: Domestic cover: room rent at actuals with no sub-limit. International cover: capped at Single Private Air-Conditioned Room (Deluxe/suites excluded).

icu.note: Both Domestic and International covers pay actual ICU charges with no sub-limit.

copayment.note: No co-payment on core inpatient/outpatient benefits. Mandatory 20% co-payment applies only on the optional Dental Plan Benefits (international cover).

sub_limits.note: Domestic: Living donor costs ₹5,000; AYUSH capped per plan tier; Rehabilitation ₹50,000; Air Ambulance per schedule. International: Living donor USD 30k/50k; Rehabilitation USD 750/2,300; Repatriation of mortal remains USD 13,500; Inpatient cash USD 175/night max 25 nights; Out-patient plan capped per tier. Core inpatient benefit up to full SI.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional aggregate deductible of USD 500 or USD 1,000 available on International inpatient benefits with corresponding premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; waived for accidents and after 12 months continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability credit from prior continuous coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 35 listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) have a 24-month waiting period. Reducible via portability.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18) for both domestic and international covers. Ectopic pregnancy is covered. Routine maternity/delivery/newborn care explicitly excluded under international cover as well.

cumulative_bonus.note: 20% of domestic base SI added per claim-free year; maximum 100% of base SI. Reduced by 20% in the year following a claim. Applicable to domestic cover only; no cumulative bonus mentioned for international cover.

restoration.note: No sum insured restoration/reset benefit mentioned anywhere in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Domestic cover: 60 days pre-hospitalisation. International cover: 45 days pre-hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Domestic cover: 180 days post-hospitalisation. International cover: 90 days post-hospitalisation.

day_care.note: Extensive list of 390+ day-care procedures in Annexure I covered under both domestic and international plans.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined in the policy but no benefit clause covers it; it is not listed in the Table of Benefits for either domestic or international cover.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered under domestic plan up to the inpatient SI (with plan-tier sub-limits: ₹5L–₹7.5L). Not covered under international plan.

organ_donor.note: Living donor medical costs for organ harvesting covered: ₹5,000 (domestic); USD 30,000/50,000 (international, plan-dependent). Animal organs and 3D-printed organs excluded.

ambulance.note: Local road ambulance covered up to SI for both domestic and international plans. Air ambulance also covered (domestic: up to schedule limit; international Imperial: USD 7,500; Imperial Plus: up to inpatient SI with medical evacuation).

modern_treatments.note: Modern treatments per Annexure III (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to sum insured under both domestic and international plans.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are explicitly excluded. Medical consumables used during hospitalisation/surgery are covered as part of inpatient treatment but standalone consumables cover/rider is not offered.

global_cover.note: International inpatient cover is a core part of the policy (Part B). Geographical area is worldwide outside India, with USA inclusion/exclusion as a plan option. Both Imperial and Imperial Plus plans include international cover.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no look-back applied and claims cannot be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes. Coverage available during grace period if premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new policies only (not applicable on renewals or portability/migration).

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted per IRDAI guidelines. Migration within Bajaj General also allowed. Note: portability/migration for Global Health Care Policy requires existing policy to cover both domestic and international health.

notable_exclusions: Maternity (excl. ectopic), dental (excl. accident inpatient), OPD mental illness, hair loss treatment, sleep disorders (excl. obstructive sleep apnoea inpatient), medical error treatment, external congenital anomalies
optional_riders: Dental Plan (international): dental treatment, dental surgery, periodontics outside India (20% co-pay); Optional aggregate deductible USD 500/1,000 on international inpatient
